description: Read and search messages, manage channels, threads, pinning and reactions, list guilds, members, roles and DMs, upload files and manage your profile on discord.com in your current tab. Uses your own logged-in Discord session.

tools.name: read_messages
tools.description: Read recent messages from a Discord channel with optional pagination (pass at most one of before/after/around). Uses the logged-in session of the current discord.com tab.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to a Discord channel in the logged-in discord.com tab, optionally replying to a message ID. Posts through the channel messages endpoint of your own session.

tools.name: add_reaction
tools.description: Add an emoji reaction to a Discord message. Accepts Unicode emoji or custom emoji in name:id form.

tools.name: remove_reaction
tools.description: Remove your own emoji reaction from a Discord message. Accepts Unicode emoji or custom emoji in name:id form.

tools.name: list_guilds
tools.description: List the Discord guilds (servers) your logged-in account belongs to, with approximate member counts.

tools.name: list_channels
tools.description: List the channels of a Discord guild (server): id, type, name, topic, position, parent category and NSFW flag.

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Read a Discord user profile by user ID, or pass '@me' for the logged-in account.

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Search messages in a Discord guild by content with optional author, channel and attachment filters. Results come grouped by context.

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: Get a specific message by its ID from a Discord channel.

tools.name: delete_message
tools.description: Delete a message from a channel.

tools.name: edit_message
tools.description: Edit an existing message. Only messages sent by the authenticated user can be edited.

tools.name: pin_message
tools.description: Pin a message in a channel. Requires Manage Messages permission.

tools.name: unpin_message
tools.description: Unpin a message from a channel. Requires Manage Messages permission.

tools.name: read_thread
tools.description: Read messages from a thread. Threads are channels, so this works like read_messages but is specific to threads.

tools.name: create_channel
tools.description: Create a new channel in a Discord guild (server). Requires Manage Channels permission.

tools.name: edit_channel
tools.description: Edit a Discord channel: name, topic, NSFW flag, or parent category.

tools.name: delete_channel
tools.description: Delete a Discord channel. This action is permanent and cannot be undone.

tools.name: create_thread
tools.description: Create a thread from a message, or a standalone thread in a channel.

tools.name: get_channel_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Discord channel.

tools.name: get_guild_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a Discord guild: description, member count, features, boost status.

tools.name: list_roles
tools.description: List all roles in a Discord guild (server), sorted by position.

tools.name: list_members
tools.description: List members in a Discord guild (server).

tools.name: list_dms
tools.description: List all open direct message channels for the authenticated user.

tools.name: open_dm
tools.description: Open or get an existing direct message channel with a user. Pass multiple IDs for a group DM.

tools.name: list_pinned_messages
tools.description: List all pinned messages in a Discord channel, newest first.

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Upload a file to a Discord channel. Supports UTF-8 text and base64-encoded binary content.
